newsitem.title: USA: Galaxy Food Q2 sales jump.
newsitem.headline: Galaxy Food Q2 sales jump.

text.p: Galaxy Foods Co said Thursday it had preliminary sales of $5 million for the second quarter ended September 30, an increase over the $511,301 in sales for the same period the prior year.
The results bring total sales for the company's first six months to about $8.3 million, compared with total sales of $3.9 million for all of the entire prior fiscal year ended March 31.
Galaxy President Angelo Morini said in a statement that the company's sales have increased steadily over the past four quarters. The trend is expected to continue, he added.
In mid-August, Galaxy had projected that sales for the quarter would "significantly" surpass the $3.3 million reported during this year's first quarter.

Galaxy has said its retail division has been gaining retail store presence for its branded products. It also has increased retail distribution through several new accounts, such as White Rose in New York, Associated Grocers in Missouri and Fleming Distributors in Florida.
The company said it plans on releasing the results "shortly," but did not offer a specific target date.
